snippet.title: Athanasia | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by classics like System Shock and Dino Crisis, Athanasia challenges you to outthink and outmanoeuvre the brute strength of your ancient adversaries. Use your wits to navigate hidden pathways and discover forgotten secrets. Gather knowledge of your foes and surroundings to take dynamic approaches to tense, hair-trigger encounters. Find caches of vital equipment and the audio logs of those who lived, worked and died in this forsaken place. Wishlist Athanasia on Steam Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761910/Athanasia/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
